title: l1qw.30(d): C confessions storage implementation (currently a stub)
description: Child of worker6-l1qw.30 (spec 18.10): confessions_post validates and rate-limits but stores NOTHING and returns 2.04 (coap_dtn.c:269-317); confessions_get returns one float record (:243-267). Implement real storage (mirroring the deaddrop buffer pattern), the 18.10 response contract, and relax the C OSCORE requirement on confessions POST to optional per spec (currently required at :287-293 where spec makes it optional — confirm with the 18.10 table before relaxing). Largest child; landable after (a).
close_reason: Force-close with verification: the confessions storage implementation this bead describes LANDED via my own 3d17292318 'feat(dtn): confessions storage per spec 18.10' (merged to main): RAM-only FIFO ring (2x768B, no-log guarantee), OSCORE-optional POST per 18.10.5, 768B cap with 4.13, 1/30s + 12/hour rate caps per 18.10.3 (uptime-based), GET returning the stored ring as SenML vd records with wired count/since queries. Re-verified: coap_dtn.c at main contains the full implementation (54 confessions-related lines; grep count confirms). Reviewer findings from that landing were fixed in-revision; follow-ups filed separately (Retry-After API gap nqtz-adjacent, iid7 rate-key collision). Bead condition satisfied.
